data: Do clickbait posts on average receive more attention than non-clickbait posts in Broadcast media?

The question asks whether clickbait posts on average receive more attention than non-clickbait posts in Broadcast media. From the caption, blue areas indicate that clickbait posts receive more attention than non-clickbait posts, while green areas indicate the opposite. In the middle row of the figure, which represents Broadcast media, the blue line is consistently above the green line across all three metrics (#reactions/post, #shares/post, and #comments/post). This indicates that clickbait posts receive more attention than non-clickbait posts in Broadcast media. Therefore, the answer is yes.
